services.name: Cross Country Skiing
services.desc: Everyone from beginners and seasoned Nordic experts are invited to enjoy our cross-country ski trails. Rentals and Lessons are located at the Minisink Lodge. Please stop at the main office first. This loop is cut into the Laurel Ridge Field and provides beginners with a great space to learn and gain confidence on their skis. This long trail follows our property line and takes skiers through beautiful forests on our property.
